title: EXPERIMENTAL Asset-Class Metadata Extension (R&D — not the stable contract)
description: NON-AUTHORITATIVE SYNTHETIC REFERENCE EXTENSION. Declares the closed asset-class vocabulary used by pack applicability scoping (QFC alignment): permitted-token RWA, tokenized fund units and sukuk certificates are in scope for permitted regimes; cryptocurrencies, stablecoins and CBDCs mirror the QFC 'Excluded Token' concept. Naming is positioning metadata, not a legal determination. See docs/ASSET_CLASS_SCOPE.md in the amanah-alpha repository.
